'''Sinsor Khal''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Hapan]] [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] who was once a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] trainee during the time of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. For reasons unknown, he was considered a failure as a Jedi, and as such was overlooked during the [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|Great Jedi Purge]]. Shortly before the Purge, he returned home to the [[Hapes Consortium/Legends|Hapes Consortium]] and eventually became a respected [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]], but his disregard for the well-being of his subjects resulted in a semi-imprisonment on [[Gallinore]] by [[Ta'a Chume]].

In an effort to isolate [[Yuuzhan Vong]] communication technology and use it to her advantage, [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]] sought out Khal during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]]. To achieve results, a captured [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] named [[Crimpler]], who had a [[Yorik-Kul|coral implant]] in his neck, was "experimented" on into a near-[[Death/Legends|death]] state. After two days, Khal got the desired results, and gave them to Jaina to use.
